in_marathi.name: Lopika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lopika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lopika is the name of the goddess Lakshmi who left her footprints on the earth. The name Lopika is derived from the words 'lopa' meaning 'feet' and 'pada' meaning 'foot'. This name signifies the blessings and prosperity that come from the goddess Lakshmi.
